mapper.sql: select b.banner_id, b.banner_title, b.banner_image, b.course_id, b.jump_url, b.sort_order, b.status, b.start_time, b.end_time, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, b.remark, c.course_name from edu_course_banner b left join edu_course c on b.course_id = c.course_id
mapper.select: where b.status = '0' and (b.start_time is null or b.start_time <= now()) and (b.end_time is null or b.end_time >= now()) order by b.sort_order asc, b.banner_id desc
